description_en: Refreshes the access credential for Weboffice by calling the RefreshWebofficeToken operation
description_zh: 调用RefreshWebofficeToken接口刷新Weboffice的访问凭证
name: RefreshWebofficeToken

parameters.help_en: The credential used to access the document preview server. You can obtain this credential by calling the GetWebofficeURL or RefreshWebofficeToken operation
parameters.help_zh: 访问文档预览服务器的凭证，通过GetWebofficeURL或者RefreshWebofficeToken获取
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The refresh token used to refresh the credential when it expires. You can obtain this token by calling the GetWebofficeURL or RefreshWebofficeToken operation
parameters.help_zh: 凭证过期时使用RefeshToken刷新凭证，通过GetWebofficeURL或者RefreshWebofficeToken获取
parameters.name: refresh_token

AccessToken.description_en: The credential used to access the document preview server
AccessToken.description_zh: 访问文档预览服务器的凭证

AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the credential. The credential is valid for 30 minutes
AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 凭证的过期时间，有效时间为30分钟

RefreshToken.description_en: The refresh token used to refresh the credential when it expires
RefreshToken.description_zh: 凭证过期时使用RefeshToken刷新凭证

RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the refresh token. The token is valid for 1 day
RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 刷新凭证的过期时间，有效时间为1天
